mechanism_narrative: A higher level of the federal funds rate directly increases the discount rate applied to equity valuations, reducing the present value of future cash flows and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate falls below 4.5%, it signals a tight labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE < 4.5%, the 20-day forward return is negative in more than 60% of instances, or the Rank IC between UNRATE and 20-day returns is less than 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low unemployment (UNRATE < 4.5%) and strong retail sales (RSAFS > 360000) indicates a robust consumer economy, which amplifies corporate earnings growth and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction effect is not significant: the Rank IC for the interaction term (UNRATE * RSAFS) is less than 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or the 20-day forward return is negative in more than 60% of instances when both conditions are met.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle, a decline in industrial production indicates a weakening manufacturing sector, which reduces corporate earnings growth and causes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: In the monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%), the 20-day forward return is positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 110, or the Rank IC for INDPRO in this regime is less than 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate above 5.0% signals weakening labor market conditions, which reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE > 5.0%, the 5-day forward return is positive in more than 60% of instances, or the Rank IC between UNRATE and 5-day returns is less than 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong housing starts indicate robust residential construction, which drives consumer confidence and corporate investment, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC between HOUST and 60-day forward returns is less than 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or the correlation is not significantly positive (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals aggressive monetary tightening, which increases borrowing costs and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, the 5-day forward return is positive in more than 60% of instances, or the Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 5-day returns is less than 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts and retail sales indicates strong consumer demand and economic expansion, which together drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction effect is not significant: the Rank IC for the interaction term (HOUST * RSAFS) is less than 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or the 60-day forward return is negative in more than 60% of instances when both conditions are met.
